title: Four-star general says MJ-12 is real

tellings.quote: four-star general who was asked about the documents. He said they're real or the Majestic 12 is real.

plain: A four-star general, asked about the MJ-12 papers (documents that describe a secret high-level group called Majestic 12, said to have been set up to handle the UFO question), is said to have answered that they are real, or that Majestic 12 is real. The online UFO researcher UAPGerb tells Michels this as something he heard, and he does not name the general. If it were true, a very senior officer would be confirming that such a secret group existed.
